scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run build:production && pnpm run deploy:preflight && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run build:production && pnpm run deploy:preflight && pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply orbit --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env production && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --keep-vars
scripts.db:migrate:production: pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply orbit --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env production
scripts.format: oxfmt package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts wrangler.jsonc wrangler.local.jsonc drizzle.config.ts vitest.config.ts scripts src/styles.css src/env.d.ts src/cloudflare.d.ts src/router.tsx src/components src/db src/lib src/routes src/server src/shared public drizzle
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts wrangler.jsonc wrangler.local.jsonc drizzle.config.ts vitest.config.ts scripts src/styles.css src/env.d.ts src/cloudflare.d.ts src/router.tsx src/components src/db src/lib src/routes src/server src/shared public drizzle
